title: Annotatio I §.V close: Morton’s figurative proofs vs Pontificii — stop before Annotatio II
pass_a_gloss: As for what remains, see the figurative sense of the Institution words proved in various ways against the Pontificians in Morton, sometime Bishop of Durham, On the Eucharist, part two Class 1 chapters 2, 3, and 4.
pass_b_english: For the rest, see Morton (sometime Bishop of Durham), On the Eucharist II Class 1 chs. 2–4, for figurative Institution proofs against the Pontificians.
source_text: Quod reliquum est, sensum verborum institutionis figurativum variis modis contra Pontificios probatum videas apud Mortonum, Episc. quondam Dunelmensem de Eucharistia, parte secunda Classe 1. cap. 2. 3. & 4.
notes: Morton vs Pontificii; stop before Annotatio II.
